broker.name: Fusion Markets
broker.tagline: Its site names FSA (Seychelles), VFSC, and ASIC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: The Fusion Markets pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Zero, Classic, and Swap-Free. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, MT5 Webtrader, TradingView, and Fusion Hub. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), VFSC, and ASIC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 0 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Clients can request an increase up to 1:500, subject to Fusion Markets approval and suitability. Spot FX and spot metal examples in that PDS are 1:100. Commodity derivatives example is 1:10.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Homepage says no minimum account size. The Zero account page says no minimum account size and that clients can start with as little as they like. The site does not attach a currency to that zero minimum. Commissions on the same pages are quoted in USD.

other_fees.label: Deposit and withdrawal fees
other_fees.note: Homepage says no fees to deposit and zero fees on deposits and withdrawals. Zero account page says no withdrawal fees.

other_fees.label: Commission on US share, crypto, energy, commodity, and index CFDs
other_fees.note: Homepage. Forex commission is separate and is the $2.25 per side Zero account rate.

other_fees.label: Swap-free administration fee
other_fees.note: ASIC FSG. No single amount is printed. The interval also varies and the details are on the platform.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, regulations, products, Zero account, MT4, and MT5 pages loaded. The ASIC FSG PDF and VFSC PDS PDF on the Fusion domain were read. No founding year was found. Offices are listed in Port Vila, Mahe, and South Yarra, and none is labelled headquarters. AFSL 385620 and Vanuatu company number 40256 are the same identifiers Global Prime publishes for FMGP Trading Group Pty Ltd and Gleneagle Securities Pty Limited. Minimum trade size on the Zero page: 0.01 for currency pairs, metals, and other commodities; 0.1 for indices and other assets. Copy trading is offered as Fusion+ on the homepage.
